summary: CMS Editor improvements testing completed. All requested features verified working: Admin login, editor activation, content sidebar with text fields, text field reordering (up/down arrows on hover), spacing control per field (Layout icon), and Layout tab with section management. Backend APIs for image upload and content persistence are working correctly.

test_results.spacing_control: PASS - Layout icon toggles spacing control with options: Kein, Klein, Mittel, Groß
